subject: lego-question-compiler-r1
acceptedClaims: The Question Compiler R1 Skill and method contract exist and preserve the derived-analysis-not-truth boundary.
The default primary question set is bounded and the pilot includes explicit pruning, discriminating outcomes, and a real INVESTIGATE/EXPERIMENT/PLAN handoff.
R1 introduces no machine-readable Question schema.
The repository regression suite passes with the R1 files present.
nonClaims: This does not prove that Question Compiler improves project outcomes across domains.
This does not justify promoting game-theoretic or information-theoretic vocabulary into the common LEGO schema.
This does not establish completeness of the question families.
nextEvidence: Prospective application on at least two non-poker Ordivon domains.
Compare compiled questions against an uncompiled baseline for decision/experiment changes.
Promote shared concepts only after repeated cross-domain evidence.
